summary: Offline Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and AI Agent identity graph modeling, privilege analysis, and exposure review.
limitations: Operates entirely on offline read-only tenant exports; does not perform live Microsoft Graph or Azure Resource Manager API calls.
Graph paths establish structural entitlement reachability and privilege relationships; they do not prove active attacker exploitation.
Requires tenant export manifests with explicit SHA-256 checksums; incomplete exports are flagged as unknown rather than asserted safe.

demo.description: Run an offline analysis of a multi-principal Entra tenant with human, app, managed identity, and Agent ID relationships.
